records.canonicalEnglish:
Sion: Karu, do you know Uncle Joe?
Karu: Yes. Joe should be living at Dust, the waste facility south of Hamack.

context.speaker: Sion / Karu
context.intent: Ask about Joe and give a qualified location.

findings: Preserves both runtime names, south of Hamack and should be. Omits the familiar Uncle address and waste facility in the constrained reply; canonical retains it.

records.canonicalEnglish:
Girl: This is Hamack. My name's Jane. What's yours?
Prompt: Tell her your name?
findings: The original name prompt uses the header area; kept within one row. Empty text span before the header retains its token and all controls. The town, self-introduction and question remain.

records.canonicalEnglish: Jane: Oh, that's a nice name. Pleased to meet you, Sion.

context.speaker: Jane
context.intent: Warm response when Sion shares his name.

findings: Shortens the meeting greeting to HI while keeping the compliment and runtime Sion reference.

context.speaker: Jane
context.intent: React to refusal to give a name.

findings: Keeps the offended response; omits the separate introductory exclamation.

records.canonicalEnglish: Jane: Sion, how are you getting on?

context.speaker: Jane
context.intent: Friendly repeat greeting after exchanging names.

findings: Uses a natural short greeting without implying a particular quest outcome.

records.canonicalEnglish: Jane: Oh? Did you want something?

context.speaker: Jane
context.intent: Ask what the player wants on the alternative repeat branch.

findings: Keeps the question; does not invent anger beyond the refusal branch.

records.canonicalEnglish: Old woman: Money matters, of course, but don't underestimate scrap.

context.speaker: Old woman
context.intent: Explain that scrap also has value.

findings: Compresses the warning not to dismiss scrap into an emphatic comparison; both kinds of value remain.

records.canonicalEnglish: Outlaw: Looking for an informant? You might find one at the underground bar.

context.speaker: Outlaw
context.intent: Suggest where to look for information.

findings: TRY preserves a suggestion rather than guaranteeing an informant will be present.

records.canonicalEnglish: Woman: Some Zolias soldiers came here a little while ago. They were terrifying. I thought they were going to kill me.

context.speaker: Woman
context.intent: Describe fear during a recent visit by soldiers.

findings: Fear is conveyed by thought they would kill me. Omits the precise recent-time phrase and the separate terrifying description.

records.canonicalEnglish: Man: In a few more years, this whole planet is bound to be covered in greenery.

context.speaker: Man
context.intent: Express confidence about the planet becoming green.

findings: Soon compresses a few more years; confidence and whole-planet scope remain.

records.canonicalEnglish:
Karu: Welcome home, Sion. Hello, Shoko.
Sion: Karu! Where did Mom go?
Karu: Karu does not know.
Shoko: Your mother's gone out?
Karu: She left without saying anything.
Sion: She didn't even say where she was going?
Karu: Karu does not know.
Sion: No use. Karu's an older model with no image playback... Nothing we can do about that. Karu, will you come help me look for Mom?
Karu: Karu will go with Sion.

context.speaker: Sion / Shoko / Karu
context.intent: Connect the search for Lucia with Karu joining.
context.tone: Concerned questioning; measured named self-reference from Karu.

adaptationAssessment.reason: Sion's single existing page combines older-model/image-playback explanation, resignation, Karu name substitution and invitation to search for Mom. Preserving these naturally exceeds 14 cells by four rows; requires verified extra paging or narrower rendering. Control-flow review for reinsertion also remains pending.

records.canonicalEnglish:
Joe: Let's head into Hamack and ask around about Lucia.
Sion: But where do we even start?
Joe: There should be informants at the bar. They might know something.

context.speaker: Joe / Sion
context.tone: Joe practical and informal; Sion uncertain.

findings: Canonical reviewed; not enabled for reinsertion. This dispatcher includes #O and many conditional targets that require control-flow review. No fitting claim yet.

records.canonicalEnglish: Girl: I hear there's a weird old man called Scrap Joe at Dust, the waste facility. He's always building shady-looking things.

context.speaker: Girl
context.intent: Present local hearsay, not an objective judgment about Joe.

findings: The insult is rendered as weird old man in the tinkering context; this does not assert sexual misconduct. Runtime name 7 currently renders only JOE, a separate known epithet omission.

adaptationAssessment.reason: The waste-facility location, hearsay, disparaging description, runtime name and recurring suspicious inventions cannot all fit naturally into one 14-cell/four-row page. Name 7 also still lacks the Scrap epithet in the current build.

context.speaker: Girl
context.intent: Simple greeting on the conditional alternative.

findings: Grouped with the rumor branch; no adaptation released separately from its blocked scene. Opaque trailing bytes remain preserved.
